newsitem.title: USA: Alrenco falls on Q4 outlook.
newsitem.headline: Alrenco falls on Q4 outlook.

text.p: Alrenco Inc's stock fell sharply Friday after the company said fourth-quarter earnings would fall short of Wall Street expectations, coming in flat to slightly below the $0.16 per share of a year ago.
First Call's consensus estimate is for earnings in a range of $0.25-$0.26 per share.

Alrenco Chief Financial Officer Theodore Wilson told Reuters that the decline in the company's stock was an overreaction by the market. "Two analysts I spoke with say they are not changing their buy recommendations," he said.
Alrenco said its quarterly revenues were expected to be in line with estimates. It did not specify the estimaqtes. Year-ago quarterly revenues were $11.3 million.
Alrenco said it was increasing advertising expenditures in the fourth quarter and planned to write off certain distressed merchandise.
The company operates rental-purchase stores in the Southeast, Mid-Atlantic and Midwest.
